args.body:
Hello,

You reported that invoices are being sent to an incorrect (old) address. We have confirmed the current billing contact on file is billing@adatum.org.

To correct this, please reply with the new, correct billing email address where you would like to receive future invoices. Once we have the new address, we will update your record.

Additionally, we are processing your requested late fee refund of 175.

Best regards,
Customer Support
